proposalConventions.identifier: Application-generated UUID v4 for every primary key; no database-specific default is proposed.
proposalConventions.timestamps: UTC instants; created_at is immutable; updated_at changes only on mutable-record updates
proposalConventions.tenantBoundary: organisation_id is the root tenant boundary; workspace-bound records also carry workspace_id and reference organisation.workspaces(id, organisation_id). A null workspace_id means organisation-wide scope; no synthetic workspace is created.
proposalConventions.deletion: Prefer state transitions and retention-controlled purge over cascading deletion of communication history
proposalConventions.payloadStorage: Attachment bytes live in an approved object-storage capability; relational rows contain opaque storage references only
proposalConventions.externalReferences: Foreign-key targets outside communications are proposed references, not closed until their target contracts are approved

crossRowInvariants: Every Communications row belongs to exactly one organisation through organisation_id.
A non-null workspace_id must reference organisation.workspaces using (workspace_id, organisation_id) -> (id, organisation_id); null workspace_id means organisation-wide scope.
Where recipient/author/user membership FKs target organisation memberships, active membership is checked by application policy at action time, not encoded in the FK.
A workspace-bound thread member must reference a workspace_membership_id belonging to the parent thread workspace, same organisation, and same user_id.
A message sender must be an active member of the referenced thread at send time.
Direct-message membership IDs are normalized in the database contract by ascending ID check plus a unique workspace pair constraint.
An attachment creator must be authorized for the parent message and its organisation; attachment retention follows the parent message.
An active legal/governance hold overrides all ordinary retention deletion and is managed by Governance/Evidence, without adding a Communications FK.
Delivery retries create distinct attempt rows; failed attempts remain immutable terminal evidence.

dependencyBlockers.note: An Organisation contract is present; reviewer must verify key type, lifecycle, and delete semantics against this proposal.
User references remain unresolved for foreign-key closure until the identity contract is approved.

unresolvedPolicyQuestions: The nine retention periods and lifecycle anchors are explicit MAATAA policy proposals, not approved retention policy or statutory requirements; legal/compliance review remains required.
identity.users is still authored-only; draft structural closure may use it, but canonical readiness and Prisma remain blocked until Identity is approved and canonical.
Workspace membership status and parent-thread membership are action-time policies; a static FK proves row identity only, not active authorization.

Target database support for composite/null-aware FKs, canonical membership-pair check constraints, JSON-free audience modeling, and immutable delivery evidence must be reviewed before physical compilation.
Announcement acknowledgement and per-recipient audience snapshots would require a new canonical table; they are excluded and recorded as future scope rather than fabricated.

tables.purpose: An in-product notification addressed to one user within one organisation.

foreignKeys.decisionNote: Null means organisation-wide scope; a non-null workspace must belong to the same organisation.
Proves recipient belongs to this organisation; active membership remains an action-time policy check.
Identity owns the user identifier and profile; Communications stores only the reference.
Proposed tenant-safe membership edge; active status remains action-time application policy.

lifecycle.mutable: state, read_at, dismissed_at, updated_at; transport is represented only by notification_deliveries
lifecycle.retentionAnchor: terminal read or dismissal time; unread items are not terminal
lifecycle.purge: 365 days after terminal/read/dismissed state; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion

baseline.use: comparison evidence only; this proposal revises state, workspace scope, and tenant-safe membership edges

tables.purpose: A user’s per-organisation opt-in/out preferences by notification category and channel; no provider credentials.

foreignKeys.decisionNote: Preferences are scoped to a recipient membership in one organisation.
Identity owns the user identifier and profile; Communications stores only the reference.

lifecycle.retentionAnchor: preference becomes inactive or owning organisation membership ends
lifecycle.purge: 90 days after inactive/terminal lifecycle; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion

tables.purpose: An append-oriented record of one channel delivery attempt for a notification.

foreignKeys.decisionNote: Prevents a delivery attempt from crossing the notification tenant boundary.

lifecycle.mutable: one attempt advances through its declared lifecycle; each retry is a new row; terminal attempt evidence is preserved
lifecycle.purge: 180 days after terminal delivery state; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion; provider secrets are prohibited

tables.retryRule: A retry creates a new attempt_number and a new row; a failed row is retained and never reset to queued.
crossRowInvariants: Provider response metadata must be allowlisted and redacted; secrets, credentials, tokens, and unrestricted payloads are prohibited.

tables.purpose: An organisation-scoped conversation container for messages and participants.

foreignKeys.decisionNote: Null means organisation-wide scope; a non-null workspace must belong to the same organisation.
Creator must be an organisation member; active status is checked by application policy when the action occurs.
Identity owns the user identifier and profile; Communications stores only the reference.

lifecycle.purge: 1095 days after close/archive; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion; child history is retained consistently

tables.purpose: Membership and per-user read position for a communication thread.

foreignKeys.decisionNote: Proves organisation membership; active status is checked by application policy.
Present for workspace-bound threads; validator/policy verifies the referenced membership belongs to the parent thread workspace and same user.
Identity owns the user identifier and profile; Communications stores only the reference.

lifecycle.retentionAnchor: thread closure or membership end, whichever is later
lifecycle.purge: 1095 days after terminal anchor; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion

crossRowInvariants: If parent thread.workspace_id is non-null, workspace_membership_id is required and must match that workspace and user_id.
If parent thread.workspace_id is null, workspace_membership_id is null and organisation membership is sufficient.

tables.purpose: An ordered text message authored within a thread.

foreignKeys.decisionNote: Sender must belong to the same organisation; active thread membership is checked at send time.
Identity owns the user identifier and profile; Communications stores only the reference.

lifecycle.mutable: body may be corrected with edited_at; redaction sets state, redacted_at, redacted_by_user_id, and reason while preserving row identity
lifecycle.purge: 1095 days after parent thread closure; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion

crossRowInvariants: sender_user_id must be an active thread member at send time.
Message redaction records actor/time and does not delete the audit row.

tables.purpose: Metadata and opaque object-storage locator for an attachment belonging to a message.

foreignKeys.decisionNote: Creator must belong to the same organisation; active thread membership is checked at upload time.

lifecycle.mutable: deleted_at only; bytes are stored outside this relational table using an opaque storage reference
lifecycle.purge: Same 1095-day parent-message lifecycle; storage object deletion must honor governance hold and follow the parent message

crossRowInvariants: The object lifecycle and metadata lifecycle must be coordinated; no binary payload is stored here.

foreignKeys.decisionNote: Null means organisation-wide scope; a non-null workspace must belong to the same organisation.

checksProposed: both memberships belong to workspace_id and organisation_id
parent communication_threads.kind = direct and parent workspace_id matches

lifecycle.purge: 1095 days after parent thread closure; governance hold overrides ordinary deletion

tables.deterministicPairRule: Database check requires membership IDs in canonical ascending order; unique constraint on organisation, workspace, and normalized pair rejects duplicates independent of caller behavior.

foreignKeys.decisionNote: Null means organisation-wide scope; a non-null workspace must belong to the same organisation.
